headline: AI agents' 'alarming' hacking skills creates rush to spend on cybersecurity
detail: This is a direct positive catalyst for cybersecurity companies. Your CRWD holding is well-positioned in this sector, and increased spending could further boost its performance.
rec: Consider adding to your CRWD position on any pullbacks, as this headline suggests strong tailwinds for the cybersecurity sector.
